headlines.text: Anthropic's mega-IPO sends stocks lower for a second day as AI-trade jitters drag Nvidia and AMD down with it
Selloff deepens at midday: Nasdaq skids as much as 2.4% and the Dow briefly dips back below 50,000 as Anthropic's IPO debut fails to calm AI-valuation jitters
AMD shares slump again premarket after a short seller alleges the chipmaker has its own 'China problem'
Nvidia slides to a fresh 52-week low as AI-trade jitters persist, a day after its Q3 beat failed to halt the stock's slide
Dow notches its worst week since April 2025 after closing below 50,000 Thursday for a sixth straight losing session
Initial jobless claims rise to 203,000 for the week ending Nov. 14, above the ~197K-208K consensus range
Trump, Xi and Putin conclude their APEC trilateral in Shenzhen with a joint declaration on nuclear-risk reduction, UN reform and boosting oil output
